final: SELECT p.bats, COUNT(*) AS count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p2 ON CAST(p2.player_id AS BLOB) = CAST(a.player_id AS BLOB)) AS share, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT AVG(group_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS group_count FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p2 ON CAST(p2.player_id AS BLOB) = CAST(a.player_id AS BLOB) GROUP BY p2.bats)) AS count_divided_by_average FROM appearances AS a JOIN player AS p ON CAST(p.player_id AS BLOB) = CAST(a.player_id AS BLOB) GROUP BY p.bats
